cohort: 215 neonates admitted to the NICU of Shohada-e-Tajrish Hospital in 2007 and 2008
finding: Mode of delivery had no significant impact on Apgar score, mortality, length of hospital stay, RDS, and infection markers in neonates admitted to the NICU.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery had no significant impact on Apgar score, mortality, length of hospital stay, RDS, and infection markers in neonates admitted to the NICU.
